d: A stone golem with a mature, stoic expression, featuring a single, glowing circular eye embedded in a smooth, white marble-like forehead. The build is massive and architectural, characterized by a body integrated into a structure of white stone and polished gold filigree, adorned with a large, glowing four-pointed star crystal on the chest. The entity is composed of white and cream-colored stone with gold ornamental plating, featuring flowing blue energy ribbons cascading from the waist. BODY COLOR: White and cream stone with gold accents LEGS: Plantigrade, constructed from heavy, carved white stone blocks
